facts.fact: The Referentiel general d'interoperabilite (RGI), a normative document fixing the rules for compatibility between public administrations' information systems, was adopted by arrete of the Prime Minister on 23 May 2018, as reported by Burkina 24 on 15 October 2019.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy and Posts (DGTIC)

note: No fact on use: the source says the rules are recommended for some and mandatory for others, names no enforcing body, and the training seminar is not public bodies exchanging data under it.
